text:
maya: Quick sync — after the release there are cross-team asks: Acme flagged embeddings latency spike and two small UX quirks. Should we do a dedicated 2-week hotfix sprint or fold into next minor?
jon: My vote: hotfix for the Acme perf regression (P0) + one UX microfix. Other bugs can queue for next minor.
sana: Agree on P0. Can we triage the other two bugs to see if they block any customers?
oliver: I ran a quick replay, looks like prefix cache miss rate jumped after the model downgrade. Suspect cache invalidation.
kwon: Yep, saw increased KV churn in logs: `shard-7 kv-miss 1.8x`. I'll open a debug PR.
maya: Good. Action: kwon owns perf patch, can we aim for a canary before EOW?
kwon: I can get a PR today, but need a review from eng-runtime. @oliver?
oliver: I can review tomorrow morning. Also propose we pair with rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h with auto-rollback.
product-ops: Add customer comms: notify Acme that we're working on a targeted fix and will share ETA by EOD.
jon: For the UX microfixes, let's pick the highest-impact one (search dropdown flicker) and include it in the hotfix sprint if it has <2 dev days. Otherwise schedule for next minor.
sana: I estimated dropdown fix ~1d, good to include.
release-bot: deploy-checklist: canary config created, smoke tests updated, runbook template assigned to maya.
maya: OK — decision: 2-week hotfix sprint starting Mon. Scope: 1 P0 perf fix (kwon), 1 UX microfix (sana), regression test additions (jon), customer comms (product-ops). Anything else?
oliver: Add a short regression eval for embeddings latency (test set + 50k tokens) so we can quantify improvement.
jon: I'll own the eval. ETA Wed.
product-ops: I'll draft the customer note and a public support KB update.
maya: Great. Follow-ups: kwon -> PR today; oliver -> review + canary plan; jon -> eval; product-ops -> comms. Sync Tue 10am to check progress. :calendar: :rocket:
